strategyFamily: equal-sleeve BNB/XRP spot-perpetual funding and basis carry
motivation: Prospectively test the same unconditional fully collateralized carry family on the next two high-liquidity non-BTC assets after the already-frozen Trial 17 ETH/SOL pair. No BNBUSDT or XRPUSDT funding/perpetual execution/mark/basis/carry series is queried for Trial 18 before this freeze.

assetSelection.rule: Starting from the already-frozen 2022 identity-clean liquidity ranking used elsewhere in the project, exclude BTC and the Trial 17 ETH/SOL replication assets; select the next two majors in rank order: BNB then XRP. Selection is fixed before Trial 18 derivative acquisition and does not use BNB/XRP carry performance.

dataPreviouslyObservedAtFreeze.interpretation: Trial 18 is an untouched derivative/carry replication, not a pristine spot-price-path test.

portfolio.sleeveMechanics: Each sleeve is a linearly scaled 50% subportfolio using the frozen Trial 2 carry formulas. Each sleeve buys spot equal to 15% of sleeve capital and shorts exactly the same coin units in its USD-M perpetual. Total starting spot exposure is 15% of portfolio equity.
portfolio.entryRule: One entry at the first exact 8-hour boundary in each evaluation window; no funding-sign filter or forecast.
portfolio.exitRule: One exit at the final exact 8-hour boundary strictly before the window end.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Do not acquire any final BNB/XRP derivative/funding row unless the frozen development gate passes.

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY spot 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M 8h markPriceKlines; exact overlap agreement required
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M fundingRate archives

developmentGate.decision: Every criterion must pass before final-holdout acquisition. Failure freezes Trial 18 without final access or in-place rescue.

promotionCriteria.decision: Every criterion must pass. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion proposal only; never real-money trading. Failure freezes Trial 18 without rescue.

multipleTesting.newInformationSet: BNBUSDT and XRPUSDT derivative/funding/basis histories not queried by prior carry trials

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 18 development output, no asset, sleeve weight, collateral, sizing, date, cost, source, funding filter, entry/exit rule, or gate may change under Trial 18.
